title: 第4章 拜师第5章 铁甲第6章 口诀
content_zh:
陆沉闻言，目光不由微微一亮。
暗伤这种东西，普通武者大多畏之如虎，但是拥有九玄镜的他可不怕。
想到这里，陆沉当即道：“只要能学武就够了，我不挑武学和武馆。”
陆恒阳叹息一声，也只好道：“以我们现在的条件，也没有挑选的余地。”
“唉！”
陆元鸿也不由感叹一声，把桌子上的包裹打开。
只见里面放着一杆老烟枪，外加一柄寒光闪闪的宝刀。
“青河也要练武，我也拿不出多少银子资助阿沉。”
“这里有柄十锻刀是我得意之作，可以抵做一两银子，明天我带你一起，拿此物去找‘楚爷’，应该能酌情减免一些束脩。”
陆恒阳有些意外的看着烟枪问道：“你怎么把这个拿来了？”
陆元鸿撇了撇嘴：“这杆烟枪是祖上传下的老物件了，枪嘴上嵌着白银，应该能卖个几百文，算是给你们补一补。”
陆恒阳不由瞪大眼睛，拿陆老头的烟枪抵卖，也就最受宠爱的幺子陆元鸿敢做了。
要是换成他和老大，那恐怕得被打断腿。
当天夜里，大房也送了一笔钱过来。
虽然只有两百文而已，但也已经算得上是尽了一份力。
“……”
“臭小子，老子的烟枪呢？”
第二天一大早，陆沉刚起床，就听到陆老头的声音。
陆元鸿嬉皮笑脸：“家里都快揭不开锅了，你还抽什么烟，我拿去卖了给清河学武。”
“我打死你个不孝子。”

陆老头气的吹胡子瞪眼，拿起拐杖就砸了过去。
陆元鸿躲过这一拐杖，拽着陆沉跑出屋子，一起往城南而去。
他们一路来到一个偏僻的小巷中，找到了一个看起来平平无奇的院落。
两人从侧门而入，找到了沈师傅门下三弟子楚阔。
“楚爷，这是小的侄儿。”
陆元鸿奉上了十锻刀，恭敬地说明了来意。
那楚阔打量了陆元鸿一眼，片刻后才开口说道：“不必客气，你师父与我也算是好友。”
“不过此事我也做不得主，你等我跟师父禀报一二。”
说到这里，楚阔便去了内院之中。
而趁此机会，陆沉打量起院落之中习武的少年。
只见沈氏武馆之中，一共有五十多个正在练武的少年，其中大多数都不到十五岁。
这些人修炼武学的同时，不少人还以柳条、木棍互相抽打，一个个被打的龇牙咧嘴的，不多时就熬不住停下来休息。
“这铁甲功修炼太过酷烈，初时以柳条，竹枝抽打，更进一步就要换上木棍、刀剑，以求激发铁甲功的独门劲力。”
“据说一旦修至大成，周身便宛如铁甲护体，刀枪不入，能击溃百名壮汉，可称百人敌，在武者之中都算好手。”
“只是天长日久的打熬自身终究有损元气，所以修炼此功之人大多会留下暗伤，除非能突破化境，否则很难以活过五十岁。”
陆元鸿摇了摇头，低声道：“内城的富商少爷和贵人，大多追求延年益寿，来此学武的大多都是平民子弟，所以沈氏武馆的束脩能够通融一些。”
正说着，远处传来一阵脚步声，两人连忙低下头不敢多言。
就在此时，内院中走出两道人影，为首的是一个头发花白的中年男人。
“小的见过沈馆主。”
陆元鸿拉着陆沉行礼，语气略微有些颤抖。
content_en:
When Lu Chen heard this, his eyes couldn't help but light up slightly.
Most ordinary warriors are afraid of such things as hidden wounds, but he who possesses the Nine Mysterious Mirror is not afraid.
Thinking of this, Lu Chen immediately said: "As long as you can learn martial arts, it's enough. I don't care about martial arts or martial arts schools."
Lu Hengyang sighed and had no choice but to say: "With our current conditions, we have no choice."
"Alas!"
Lu Yuanhong couldn't help but sigh and opened the package on the table.
I saw an old smoking gun and a gleaming sword inside.
"Qing He also wants to practice martial arts, and I can't afford much money to support Chen."
"There is a ten-forged sword here which is my favorite work. It can be worth one tael of silver. Tomorrow I will take you with me to take this thing to 'Master Chu'. I should be able to reduce some of the repairs as appropriate."
Lu Hengyang looked at the pipe in surprise and asked, "Why did you bring this?"
Lu Yuanhong curled his lips: "This pipe is an old item passed down from our ancestors. The mouth of the pipe is embedded with silver. It should be sold for a few hundred coins. It can be used as a replacement for you."
Lu Hengyang couldn't help but widen his eyes, and offered Old Man Lu's pipe as a trade, which was the most favored youngest son, Lu Yuanhong, who dared to do so.
If it were him and the boss, their legs would probably be broken.
That night, Dafang also sent a sum of money.
Although it is only two hundred pieces of writing, it can be considered as a contribution.
"..."
"You brat, where's my pipe?"
Early the next morning, as soon as Lu Chen got up, he heard Old Man Lu's voice.
Lu Yuanhong smiled playfully: "It's almost too late to open the fire at home. Why are you still smoking? I'll sell it to Qinghe Xuewu."
"I'll beat you to death, you unfilial son."
Old Man Lu blew his beard and glared angrily, picked up the crutch and smashed it over.
Lu Yuanhong dodged the crutch, dragged Lu Chen out of the house, and headed south of the city together.
They went all the way to a remote alley and found an ordinary-looking courtyard.
The two entered through the side door and found Chu Kuo, the third disciple of Master Shen.
"Master Chu, this is my nephew."
Lu Yuanhong presented the ten-forged sword and respectfully explained his purpose.
Na Chu Kuo looked at Lu Yuanhong, and after a moment he said, "You're welcome, your master and I can be considered good friends."
"But I can't make the final decision on this matter. Just wait until I report it to Master."
Having said this, Chu Kuo went to the inner courtyard.
Taking this opportunity, Lu Chen looked at the young man practicing martial arts in the courtyard.
I saw more than fifty young people practicing martial arts in Shen's martial arts gym, most of whom were less than fifteen years old.
While these people were practicing martial arts, many of them beat each other with wicker sticks and wooden sticks. Everyone was so beaten that they grinned, and after a while they couldn't bear to stop and rest.
"The practice of the Iron Armor Kung Fu is too intense. In the beginning, you will be beaten with willow sticks and bamboo branches. Later, you will need to use wooden sticks and swords, in order to stimulate the unique strength of the Iron Armor Kung Fu."
"It is said that once the cultivation is completed, the whole body will be like an iron armor, invulnerable to weapons and weapons, and can defeat hundreds of strong men. It can be said to be the enemy of a hundred people. It is considered a good skill among warriors."
"It's just that long-term hard work will eventually damage one's vitality, so most people who practice this skill will be left with hidden wounds. Unless they can break through the realm of transformation, it will be difficult to live past the age of fifty."
Lu Yuanhong shook his head and whispered: "Most of the wealthy businessmen and nobles in the inner city are seeking to prolong their lives. Most of the people who come here to learn martial arts are ordinary people, so the cultivators at Shen's Martial Arts School can be more accommodating."
Just as they were talking, there was a sound of footsteps in the distance, and the two of them quickly lowered their heads and did not dare to say anything.
At this moment, two figures walked out of the inner courtyard, led by a middle-aged man with gray hair.
"The young one has met Master Shen."
Lu Yuanhong pulled Lu Chen to salute, his tone slightly trembling.
